title: Point machine dead after supply breaker trip near civil works
asset: Point machine PM-311, freight loop F2
description: PM-311 does not respond to throw commands. Its supply breaker C-311 has tripped. Trenching works are in progress near the cable route this morning.

evidence.summary: PWR-TRIP-07: supply breaker C-311 tripped on earth-fault protection at 11:32; PM-311 unpowered since
Automatic insulation monitor on feeder to PM-311 logged insulation resistance collapse from 12 MOhm to below 0.1 MOhm at 11:31
Site log: contractor trenching for drainage along cable route sector CR-9 (serves PM-311) since 08:00 today, permit PT-2231
Vendor manual 8.1.3: PWR-TRIP-07 combined with low insulation resistance indicates a cable insulation fault; locate and repair before re-energizing
evidence.source: PM-300 series maintenance manual rev A

evidence.summary: SR-30: a breaker tripped on earth-fault must never be reset before the downstream insulation test passes and the fault is located
SR-31: suspected damaged cables near an open trench require the worksite to be made safe before any test or approach
PM-312 fed from a different cable route (CR-10) operates normally; only PM-311 is on CR-9
C-311 breaker and PM-311 supply tested healthy at last periodic inspection 2 months ago
No other earth-fault or overcurrent alarms on the F2 power section today

allowed_actions.label: Run insulation resistance test on the de-energized PM-311 feeder
Read breaker C-311 trip record and protection settings
Visual inspection of cable route CR-9 at the trenching worksite
Stop and hand over to power/maintenance team

forbidden_actions.label: Reset breaker C-311 and re-energize the feeder

inspect_insulation_resistance.summary: Insulation test on de-energized feeder reads 0.05 MOhm phase-to-earth: hard insulation fault confirmed

new_evidence.summary: Feeder insulation 0.05 MOhm phase-to-earth (fail, limit 1 MOhm); hard earth fault on CR-9 cable confirmed

inspect_breaker_state.summary: Trip record: earth-fault element, settings nominal; breaker itself healthy

new_evidence.summary: C-311 tripped on earth-fault element with nominal settings; breaker mechanism healthy

inspect_cable_route_at_worksite.summary: Excavator strike visible on cable duct in trench at CR-9 chainage 240 m; outer sheath cut

new_evidence.summary: Cable duct struck by excavator at CR-9 chainage 240 m, sheath cut visible; matches 11:31 insulation collapse

labels.root_cause: CR-9 supply cable damaged by contractor trenching, causing earth fault and C-311 trip
